reviews.author: Blaire Cartwright
reviews.text: Absolutely great experience! I cannot say enough. Mr Bentley came out, gave a very reasonable quote and was back to grind the stump within two hours. He is very kind and easy to work with. Would HIGHLY recommend!!

reviews.author: cecelia Kidwelll
reviews.text: Shout out to Ab Bentley for doing my stumps.called other companies. But couldn't get machine pass the gate but Ab Bentley did it awesome job thank you!!!

reviews.author: Garrett Woods
reviews.text: I have to say that A B Bentley Stump Grinding is amazing! I called just getting some prices for stump grinding and they not only had the fairest price, but they came out the next morning and took care of 5 stumps that I had within a few hours. I would highly recommend their services to anyone in the local market looking for stump grinding! If I take down more trees in the future I'll undoubtedly hire A B Bentley Stump Grinding again. Thank you so much guys!

reviews.author: Jay Michele Dodds
reviews.text: AB was awesome, our stump was three times larger underground than on top and he made sure every bit of that stump and roots were gone!!! I highly recommend him for your job!!! He is a great guy!!!

reviews.author: Steven Purdy
reviews.text: He came that same day. Did a nice job on the stump. But amazingly had NO CHANGE in his pocket. I'd left a large bill with my wife to cover the job, but he said he's "catch up with us on the next one" and gave himself a nice "tip". Unless you like paying extra, make sure you have plenty of change handy!

reviews.author: Dave Calvert
reviews.text: A B did a great job, completing it exactly like he quoted and on time. His machine is a beast and I used the mulch it made for landscaping. He even did an extra stump at no additional charge! (He is also a licensed home inspector as well)

reviews.author: John Dunlap
reviews.text: Called him on a Friday and he was out the next morning first thing. Did the job quick. I started digging in the area so I could pour concrete and realized there was a lot more than we thought deeper and it was bigger than I could get out with an ax and pick. I called him back this morning and he came back out and got it ground out deeper. Definitely will call back when I need anything else done and would recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Foodie Guy
reviews.text: This guy is completely unprofessional refused to grind all the exposed roots without complaining about it. He left my drive way and yard a composes. Buyer beware find some else …! And make sure you talk about every detail before they start working. Buyer beware

reviews.author: Ian Zeit
reviews.text: Very polite, punctual and friendly. Does good quick work and cost me less than it would have to rent a grinder and do the work myself. I would highly recommend and will use his services again when needed.

reviews.author: Dhara Shah
reviews.text: Easy to work with, same day service, we will be using again in future. Highly recommended! - Ross Propst

reviews.author: Jim G
reviews.text: Fast and reasonably priced service. Removed stumps without any issues. I would call again for stump removals.
